description: Governed closed vocabularies for the form facet: the meaning.kind values for form-family nodes, the field_type input primitives, and the content_disposition authoring-lifecycle values. This CLOSES the open, ad-hoc field_type vocabulary observed in raw form object models (the ALSAP FORM-AST-34037 draft used 20+ un-governed type strings such as 'controlled_choice_plus_rationale', 'person_signature_block', 'narrative_formula', 'boolean_plus_note'). Same governance pattern as intent.enum.json and procedure.enum.json.

governance.rule: Form facets may only use ids defined here. New values require a version bump and an entry; the validator rejects anything else. field_type and content_disposition in form.facet.schema.json are MIRRORS of these ids — a conformance check asserts (schema enum == vocab ids) so there is no drifting second copy.
reuses: registry/roles.registry.json (performed_by) — shared with procedure facet, not duplicated
registry/records.registry.json (captures_record) — shared with procedure facet, not duplicated
governance.shape: Governed values nest under dimensions.<name>.values[].id — the canonical vocab shape shared with procedure.enum.json and structure.enum.json. v0.2 normalised this file from its earlier top-level {kinds, field_type, content_disposition} layout; ids, labels and definitions are unchanged.

meaning_kind.description: meaning.kind values for form-family nodes. Container kinds carry no field_type.

values.label: Form
values.definition: Container atom for a whole form/template (e.g. the ALSAP).

values.label: Form Section
values.definition: Intermediate container grouping fields; maps a template section.

values.label: Form Field
values.definition: A leaf that captures one unit of input; carries a field_type.

field_type.description: Closed set of input primitives. Specializations (version strings, schedules, formulas) are expressed via constraints.format or meaning.kind — NOT as new field_types. Composite source fields (choice+rationale, boolean+note) DECOMPOSE into multiple field atoms; a smashed composite type is drift, not a primitive.

values.label: Short text
values.definition: Single-line free text (codes, names, short answers).

values.label: Long text / narrative
values.definition: Multi-line prose (narrative, method, summary, schedule text).

values.label: Date
values.definition: A calendar date; display/entry format via constraints.format.

values.label: Number
values.definition: A numeric value; bounds via constraints.min / constraints.max.

values.label: Boolean
values.definition: Yes/No. A paired explanation is a SEPARATE text_long field, not part of this one.

values.label: Single choice
values.definition: Exactly one value from a controlled set (options_ref). A paired rationale is a SEPARATE field.

values.label: Multiple choice
values.definition: Zero-or-more values from a controlled set (options_ref).

values.label: Person
values.definition: A named-person slot on the template. The blank slot is not PII; a filled value is a submission, held elsewhere.

values.label: Signature block
values.definition: A Part-11 signature slot (name / title / date). Filled = submission/record, not template.

values.label: Repeating table
values.definition: Tabular structure; rows repeat (constraints.repeatable). Columns are child field atoms.

values.label: Repeating group
values.definition: A repeatable cluster of fields that is not tabular.

values.label: Rule
values.definition: A structured decision / threshold / trigger expressed as governed logic (e.g. SAC referral).

values.label: Matrix
values.definition: A 2-D map of domain x domain (e.g. safety domain x deliverable).

content_disposition.description: Authoring lifecycle of a field's standard/source text, lifted from the FORM template's own global rules (FORM_RULE_005/006/007). Governs what a downstream projection/author may do with the standard text.

values.label: Controlled standard text
values.definition: Retain unchanged unless absolutely necessary; if not applicable, keep the section and enter 'Not Applicable'. (FORM_RULE_005)

values.label: Authorable
values.definition: Asset-specific content the author writes or customizes.

values.label: Example
values.definition: May be used as-is, modified, or deleted. (FORM_RULE_006)

values.label: Instructional (remove before final)
values.definition: Guidance to the author; must be deleted once the section is complete. (FORM_RULE_007)
